summary: The best week on this account since early August, and it still does not touch the two things that matter most. Volume went from 10 messages to 50 (22 hers, up from 3), and her warmth came back with it — 'Hiii sounds amazing I’d love that thankyou!!🩷'. Three real things went right. Stephski sent the Aug 15-31 invoice ON Sep 1 at 16:51, on the promised day, with no referral-delay language and no error; Sarah paid it the next morning and Stephski confirmed with 'You rock!' — the first clean billing cycle since Aug 3 and the direct reversal of last week's top failure. Olivia opened the first non-billing thread in three weeks, creating an 'OFTV' topic on Aug 31 and getting a catch-up call done on Sep 2 after some back-and-forth. And Vivek finally typed in this chat for the first time since Aug 9. Against that: her MAIN Instagram @sarah.h44 (~530k) is now 26 days suspended and was not mentioned by a single person all week — not by us, and for a third consecutive week not by her. On Sep 1 she volunteered the usernames of her two OTHER down accounts (@onlysarahh_xx, @sarah.hxx) and did not name her main page. Vivek's entire contribution was 'Which one', 'Need password' and 'Sarah hi ma’am send the password for suspended account'; nothing has been recovered and by Sep 4 she had not sent the password. Her earnings question is 27 days old with still no plan, and the only growth action anyone took was Mayson demanding '7 reels a week so 30 in total per month' of strictly fresh content — which she immediately pushed back on. She paid in a single transfer for the second cycle running, which continues to imply billings below her 50k AUD bank cap. And the credential-in-group-chat exposure got worse, not better: Olivia asked for 'both page login credentials' on Aug 28 and Vivek asked for a password twice in a ~19-person chat.

health.rationale: Up 11 from 41, the largest single-week move on this account, and every point of it is earned by things that actually happened rather than by relief. Engagement recovered hard: 50 messages against 10 last week, 22 from her against 3, back to the July/early-August baseline. Her tone reverted to the hedged, warm register she used for eleven months — 'Hiii sounds amazing I’d love that thankyou!!🩷', 'Thanks guys🩷', 'Thankyou! Tbh if it has to be all fresh...' — which reverses the single most alarming qualitative signal in last week's file. Operationally the billing loop closed cleanly: the Sep 1 invoice arrived on the promised day, correct, with no 'gathering your referrals' excuse, breaking a three-cycle pattern (Jul 1-14 re-issue, Jul 15-31 slipped to Aug 3, Aug 1-14 slipped to Aug 21); she paid inside 18 hours with no chasing. Olivia did the thing last week's report demanded of Derrek — opened a non-billing conversation and got on a call — and Michelle Queue held the leak cadence for a fifth straight week. Sarah also broke her own silence on the down accounts, asking 'Is my other 2 accounts back again?' on Aug 31 after 23 days of not asking. That is a client re-engaging, not one leaving. What keeps this at 52 and not 65: nothing was actually recovered, fixed or planned. @sarah.h44 is 26 days dead and NOBODY said its name this week — she listed two other usernames instead, which reads like she has quietly written the main account off. The Aug 6 accounts are 29 days open and moved from being blocked on a screenshot to being blocked on a password; Vivek's three messages contained no status, no timeline and no apology for 22 days of silence. The earnings plan is 27 days overdue with no owner and our only response this week was to ask her for 30 more reels a month while her 530k traffic driver is dead. Derrek's Phone Farm updates are 34 days overdue. And the second consecutive single-transfer payment says ALTR's take on this account is still roughly half what it was. The relationship recovered this week; the delivery did not. If the Sep 15 invoice is clean AND someone puts a written @sarah.h44 answer and an earnings plan in front of her, this goes to 65+. If next week is another clean invoice and nothing else, it drifts back down — she will have learned that the only reliable thing we do is bill her.
